name: Hip-hop drums and instruments
note: Written for ACE-Step 1.5, which wants dense comma-separated tags rather than sentences. Every preset is instrumental. Durations are longer than the loop you want on purpose — see the guide.

categories.name: Boom bap drums
categories.note: Swung sixteenths, 12-bit sampler crunch, room on the snare. Isolate the drums stem afterwards; ACE-Step nearly always adds a bassline you didn't ask for.

presets.name: Dusty break
presets.prompt: boom bap hip hop drum break, 92 bpm, dusty sampled acoustic kit, SP-1200 12-bit crunch, tight muffled kick, cracking rimshot snare with short room, swung sixteenth hi-hats, vinyl crackle, drums only, no melody, narrow dry mix

presets.name: Hard 90s New York
presets.prompt: east coast boom bap drums, 90 bpm, hard compressed break, thick punchy kick, loud snappy snare, closed hats on eighths, sampled from 1970s funk record, MPC60 swing, gritty saturated drums, no instruments

presets.name: Drunk swing
presets.prompt: neo soul hip hop drums, 88 bpm, unquantised loose drunk groove, laid back snare behind the beat, soft warm kick, brushed ghost notes, tape saturation, humanised timing, drums only, no bass, no melody
presets.workflow: isolate drums; do NOT quantise — the timing is the point

presets.name: Jazzy brushed kit
presets.prompt: jazz rap drums, 94 bpm, brushed snare, soft ride cymbal, light kick, upright jazz drum kit, warm 1960s recording, subtle swing, drums and cymbals only, no piano, no bass

presets.name: Heavily filtered
presets.prompt: boom bap drums, 86 bpm, low pass filtered drum break, muffled dark kit, dull thumping kick, soft dusty snare, hats barely audible, heavy vinyl noise, lo-fi sampler, drums only

categories.name: Lo-fi drums
categories.note: Softer, slower, more tape character. These sit under jazz chords rather than carrying a track.

presets.name: Sleepy tape kit
presets.prompt: lo-fi hip hop drums, 78 bpm, soft dusty kit, muffled kick, brushed snare with tape wobble, quiet shaker, vinyl crackle, warm cassette saturation, gentle swing, drums only, no chords

presets.name: Crisp lo-fi
presets.prompt: lo-fi hip hop drums, 84 bpm, clean tight kit, short snappy snare, closed hats sixteenths, light sidechain pump, subtle vinyl noise, modern lo-fi production, drums only, no melody

presets.name: Halftime lo-fi
presets.prompt: lo-fi hip hop drums, 70 bpm, halftime feel, deep soft kick, wide lazy snare on three, sparse hats, heavy room reverb, tape hiss, drums only

categories.name: Trap and drill drums
categories.note: Write the fast tempo, not the halftime one — 140 bpm, not 70. ACE-Step responds to the literal number and you want the hats subdividing correctly.

presets.name: Modern trap kit
presets.prompt: trap drums, 140 bpm, deep distorted 808 sub bass, tight layered clap and snare on the three, rapid triplet hi-hat rolls, open hat accents, sparse arrangement, heavy sub weight, clean modern mix, drums and 808 only, no melody
presets.workflow: isolate drums and bass separately, slice 4 bars

presets.name: Dark trap
presets.prompt: dark trap drums, 144 bpm, booming detuned 808, crisp rimshot, stuttering sixteenth and thirty-second hi-hats, sparse ominous space, tape distortion on the low end, percussion only, no instruments

presets.name: UK drill
presets.prompt: uk drill drums, 142 bpm, sliding glide 808 bass, syncopated snare on the three and off-beat, skittering hi-hat patterns with triplet fills, dark sparse percussion, punchy tight kick, drums and sliding bass only
presets.workflow: isolate bass stem for the 808 slides

presets.name: Memphis grit
presets.prompt: memphis rap drums, 138 bpm, crude distorted drum machine, overdriven kick, thin harsh snare, simple hat pattern, heavily saturated and clipped, cassette generation loss, drums only, no melody

categories.name: Funk and west coast drums
categories.note: Live-feel kits. Useful when you want something to chop rather than something already arranged.

presets.name: Raw funk break
presets.prompt: 1970s funk drum break, 96 bpm, live acoustic kit, open room microphones, syncopated ghost notes, ringing snare, tight kick, tambourine, analogue tape recording, drum break solo, no other instruments
presets.workflow: isolate drums, slice 2 bars — this is what you chop

presets.name: G-funk groove
presets.prompt: west coast g-funk drums, 94 bpm, crisp punchy kit, tight snare with short decay, shaker and tambourine, laid back groove, clean 1990s production, drums and percussion only

presets.name: Soul drummer
presets.prompt: 1960s soul drum break, 100 bpm, dry vintage kit, cracking snare, simple driving pattern, mono recording, slight tape compression, drums only, no horns, no bass

categories.name: Keys and chords
categories.note: The best category for transcribing to MIDI afterwards — monophonic-ish lines and slow chords transcribe far better than dense arrangements.

presets.name: Rhodes seventh chords
presets.prompt: solo fender rhodes electric piano, 88 bpm, F minor, lush jazzy seventh and ninth chords, slow warm progression, gentle tremolo, tape saturation, close mic, no drums, no bass, no other instruments
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI, replay with your own Rhodes

presets.name: Dusty upright piano
presets.prompt: solo upright piano, 90 bpm, D minor, sparse melancholy chord progression, felt dampened hammers, slightly detuned, vinyl crackle, close intimate recording, no drums, no bass
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI; slice the best 4 bars

presets.name: Wurlitzer soul
presets.prompt: solo wurlitzer electric piano, 92 bpm, B flat major, warm soulful chords with gentle overdrive, 1970s recording, spring reverb, no drums, no bass, no vocals

presets.name: Hammond organ
presets.prompt: solo hammond organ, 86 bpm, E flat major, gospel chord voicings, slow leslie rotation, drawbar warmth, tube amplifier saturation, no drums, no bass
presets.workflow: slice 4 bars; transcription is rough on organ

presets.name: Dark drill piano
presets.prompt: solo dark piano, 142 bpm, C sharp minor, sparse ominous single note melody, wide reverb tail, cold classical tone, minor key tension, no drums, no bass, no other instruments
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI — monophonic lines come out cleanest

presets.name: Celeste and bells
presets.prompt: solo celesta and glockenspiel, 80 bpm, A minor, simple delicate music box melody, sparse notes, long decay, slight detune, dreamy reverb, no drums, no bass

categories.name: Strings, brass and woodwind
categories.note: The classic sample-flip sources. Generate long, find the one bar that sounds like a record.

presets.name: Soul strings
presets.prompt: 1970s soul string section, 90 bpm, G minor, lush cinematic violins and cellos, sweeping legato phrase, warm analogue tape recording, slight wow and flutter, orchestral, no drums, no bass, no vocals

presets.name: Funk brass stabs
presets.prompt: funk horn section, 96 bpm, E flat, punchy syncopated trumpet and saxophone stabs, tight brass hits, 1970s soul recording, bright and forward, no drums, no bass, no vocals

presets.name: Jazz flute line
presets.prompt: solo jazz flute, 88 bpm, C minor, breathy improvised melodic phrase, warm 1970s recording, light room reverb, single instrument, no drums, no bass, no piano
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI — flute is the best case for monophonic tracking

presets.name: Noir saxophone
presets.prompt: solo tenor saxophone, 84 bpm, B flat minor, slow smoky melodic line, breathy tone, distant room reverb, late night jazz club, no drums, no bass, no piano

presets.name: Drill string ostinato
presets.prompt: dark orchestral strings, 142 bpm, F sharp minor, tense repeating staccato violin ostinato, low cello drone, cinematic menace, sparse, no drums, no bass, no percussion
presets.workflow: slice 2 bars, layer under drill drums

presets.name: Harp figure
presets.prompt: solo concert harp, 76 bpm, D major, cascading arpeggio figure, glissando sweeps, bright resonant plucks, natural hall reverb, single instrument, no drums, no bass
presets.workflow: slice sweeps as transitions and fills

categories.name: Bass
categories.note: Generate alone rather than isolating from a mix — separated bass has artefacts that show badly when you pitch it. Transcribes to MIDI reliably.

presets.name: Upright walking bass
presets.prompt: solo upright double bass, 92 bpm, F minor, walking jazz bass line, warm woody fingered tone, subtle string buzz, close mic 1960s recording, single instrument, no drums, no piano
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI — pitch tracking is exact down to C1

presets.name: Moog sub bass
presets.prompt: solo moog analogue synth bass, 94 bpm, C minor, fat round sub bass line, slight portamento glide, low pass filtered, warm analogue saturation, single instrument, no drums, no melody
presets.workflow: transcribe to MIDI, replay through your own synth

presets.name: 808 slides
presets.prompt: solo 808 sub bass, 142 bpm, G minor, long sliding glide notes between pitches, distorted saturated low end, long decay tails, single instrument, no drums, no hats, no melody
presets.workflow: slice; MIDI will miss the glides — redraw pitch bends

presets.name: Fingered electric bass
presets.prompt: solo electric bass guitar, 96 bpm, E minor, syncopated funk bass line, fingered round tone, light compression, 1970s recording, single instrument, no drums, no guitar

presets.name: Nylon guitar figure
presets.prompt: solo nylon string acoustic guitar, 86 bpm, A minor, gentle fingerpicked repeating figure, warm intimate close recording, slight fret noise, single instrument, no drums, no bass, no vocals

presets.name: Hollow-body jazz guitar
presets.prompt: solo hollow body electric jazz guitar, 90 bpm, D minor, mellow chord melody with seventh voicings, warm clean tube amplifier, spring reverb, 1960s recording, no drums, no bass

presets.name: Psych fuzz guitar
presets.prompt: solo electric guitar, 98 bpm, E minor, fuzzy psychedelic riff, heavy tremolo and spring reverb, 1960s garage recording, tape saturation, single instrument, no drums, no bass

presets.name: Vibraphone
presets.prompt: solo vibraphone, 84 bpm, B flat major, soft mallet melody with motor tremolo, jazzy extended chords, warm resonant tone, natural room, single instrument, no drums, no bass

categories.name: Percussion and one-shots
categories.note: One-shots are the hardest thing to get from a song model. Generate a repeating pattern of one instrument and slice single hits out of it.

presets.name: Percussion layer
presets.prompt: hand percussion loop, 92 bpm, congas bongos shaker and tambourine, dry close recording, syncopated latin pattern, no kick, no snare, no melody, percussion only
presets.workflow: layer over a drum loop for movement

presets.name: Kick one-shots
presets.prompt: solo bass drum, 80 bpm, single isolated kick drum hits with long gaps of silence, deep punchy tone, dry close mic, no snare, no hats, no melody, no other instruments
presets.workflow: slice individual hits; expect to salvage 2-3 usable ones

presets.name: Snare one-shots
presets.prompt: solo snare drum, 80 bpm, single isolated snare hits with silence between, cracking rimshot tone, short room decay, vintage kit, no kick, no hats, no melody

presets.name: Hi-hat one-shots
presets.prompt: solo hi-hat cymbal, 80 bpm, isolated closed and open hi-hat hits, crisp bright metallic tone, dry close recording, no kick, no snare, no melody

presets.name: Vinyl texture bed
presets.prompt: vinyl record surface noise, 90 bpm, crackle hiss and pops, dusty needle on empty groove, warm analogue noise floor, no music, no drums, no melody
presets.workflow: loop under everything at low level

categories.name: Full beats
categories.note: When you want a whole arrangement to separate into stems rather than a single loop. This is where ACE-Step is actually on home ground.

presets.name: Boom bap beat
presets.prompt: boom bap hip hop instrumental, 92 bpm, F minor, dusty sampled drum break, filtered soul sample chop, upright bass line, sparse rhodes stabs, vinyl crackle, 1990s east coast production, narrow dry mix, instrumental
presets.workflow: separate stems, then transcribe the melodic ones to MIDI

presets.name: Lo-fi beat
presets.prompt: lo-fi hip hop instrumental, 80 bpm, C major, soft dusty drums, jazzy rhodes seventh chords, warm upright bass, tape wobble, vinyl crackle, mellow late night mood, instrumental

presets.name: Drill beat
presets.prompt: uk drill instrumental, 142 bpm, F sharp minor, sliding 808 bass, skittering hi-hats, snare on the three, dark staccato string ostinato, sparse ominous arrangement, modern clean mix, instrumental
